title: 構造力学Ⅱ
subtitle: Structural Mechanics II
keywords: Stress-strain relationship 2.Sectional moment of inertia 3.Moment of inertia area 4.Stress of structural members 5.Influence line
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn the strength and stress-strain relationship of materials. (2) learn about the sectional moment of inertia and moment of inertia area. (3) learn how to estimate flexural and shear stresses in beams. (4) learn the concept of influence lines in static beams. (5) learn how to estimate cross sectional forces using influence lines.
advice: This is the second basic structural mechanics course. We will cover the following topics: 1. Estimating reaction and shear forces and flexural moment using influence lines 2. Stress and strain 3. Sectional moment of inertia and moment of inertia area 4. Stress in structural members 5. Estimating shear stress and flexural stress in beam members 6. The influence line concept These concepts are often used in structural design. Students should gain a deep understanding of this material. The concepts are also useful in studying Structural Mechanics Analysis, design project/implementing and operation, Reinforced Concrete and civil engineering design.

activityGoals.body: Students can explain the relationship between stress and strain.
Students can estimate the sectional moment of inertia and moment of inertia area of complex cross sections.
Students can estimate the shear stress and flexural stress in beam members.
Students can estimate reaction and shear forces and flexural moment using influence lines.
